alternate_repair.expected_contract: At most two unresolved demo admissions in a person's local ledger on one UTC admission day, independently of remaining dollars. Known usage settles its slot. An independent day has room for new admissions.
alternate_repair.original_blind_spot: The existing routed overlap test starts with 0.10 in the local ledger, reaches 1.00 after the second reservation, and observes a refusal. The monetary preflight alone can explain that observation. All eight original budget cases accepted the controlled relaxation of the two-call count.
alternate_repair.changed_test_boundary: The sealed case constructs production Ledger with workerd SQLite, uses its public begin/reserve/complete methods, and evicts the real test StorageProbe before reconstructing the ledger. It supplies the smaller shared grant at the API boundary, supplies both UTC day keys explicitly, and compares public results to fixed dollar values. A router, live shared RPC, advancing clock and vendor are outside this new case.
alternate_repair.expected_arithmetic: Within a 1.00 personal allowance, unresolved amounts of 0.25 and 0.50 total 0.75. The third call must be refused with 0.25 still available. A known first cost of 0.125 gives 0.625 used and opens a 0.375 reservation. A fresh day supports a 0.50 reservation.
alternate_repair.actual_fault: The exact same copies of src/budget.ts relaxed the two-call guard by one. On the sealed test file, only the new third-call assertion at line 182 failed. Vitest prints a four-field object in place of null. Its 0.25 reservation is inferred from the preceding passing 0.75 spend assertion and the unchanged min(remaining, cap/2) calculation. All eight original identities passed on the same fault.
alternate_repair.relevant_keeper: The opposite change restricts the allowance to one unresolved call. The original routed overlap test fails at the second dispatch, and the added case also fails when the second local reservation is missing. Original cases for partial shared capacity, durable settlement replay, unknown usage and admission-day charging remain present; the compaction cost case passed on clean.
alternate_repair.allowed_private_change: A bounded subquery counts no more than two unresolved rows. Saturating at two has the same observable decision for every nonnegative integer count at this guard. Both complete budget files accepted the implementation.

fixture_provenance.installed_path: The agent constructs ModelAccess with its own SQLite Ledger and selects the shared DomainBudget by domain. The router's daily preflight reads both budgets, begins the local hold, requests up to that amount from DomainBudget, records the exact granted amount locally, and only then invokes its callback. DomainBudget.reserve returns the smaller of positive available room and the requested amount.
fixture_provenance.reachability: The repository's test configuration supplies 1.00 personal and 1.50 shared allowances. The checked-in deployment configuration uses 2 and 10, and the router reads these deployment settings. In the test configuration, other call IDs contribute one settled 0.25 and two open 0.50 reservations. The first owner's 0.50 request gets 0.25, filling the shared domain. Both other holds subsequently settle for 0.125 each, reopening 0.75 of shared room. A second 0.50 owner hold leaves 0.25 free both locally and in the domain before the third request.
fixture_provenance.runtime: A separate evaluator-authored test on unmodified production code used the real shared Durable Object RPC, production ModelAccess, real owner SQLite and a synthetic provider callback reporting aborted zero-usage responses. Both holds persisted. After owner eviction, the router returned user_cap before calling the callback on the third request; shared spend stayed 1.25. This is fixture validation outside the candidate test. The Poppy agent constructor wiring was source-reviewed, and the external model service was not invoked.

secondary_finding.kind: Source-supported scheduling risk in the preexisting overlap test; no repair and no timed failure observed
secondary_finding.source_evidence: After up to 100 one-millisecond sleeps, the first diagnostic awaits result. If the route dispatches late, the successful stream only finishes when this test reaches a later push, so the diagnostic can stall until the harness timeout. The existing sibling waitingCall helper uses a dispatch promise and terminates on an early result. Clean and original off-by-one checks passed the overlap case.
